_note: The vocabulary the engine can currently execute. Anything not listed here is not implemented.

j_cut.note: Set clips[].audio.lead (seconds): the next clip's sound begins under the previous picture.

l_cut.note: Set clips[].audio.tail (seconds): this clip's sound carries over the next picture.

dip.note: clips[].fade_in / fade_out in seconds, to black. Use rarely, as punctuation.

dissolve.note: Not implemented yet. Use a hard cut, a dip, or a J/L audio bridge.

speed_ramp.note: clips[].ramp {from,to,steps}. Forbidden on factual_incident clips in documentary mode unless an integrity_note is given.

freeze.note: clips[].freeze true holds the first frame of the clip's in-point for its duration.

match_cut.note: An editorial decision, achieved by choosing clip order and focus points. Not an effect.
